newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean ex-minister arrested over arms scandal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean ex-minister arrested over arms scandal.

text.p: South Korean prosecutors arrested sacked defence minister Lee Yang-ho on Saturday shortly after a criminal court issued an arrest warrant in connection with an arms deal.
"Mr Lee has been arrested and he will be taken to a Seoul prison," a prosecution official told Reuters.

State prosecutors charged Lee, who was removed from President Kim Young-sam's cabinet last week, with bribery and leaking official secrets to an arms dealer over a government purchase of military helicopters.
Senior prosecutor Ahn Kang-min told reporters that Lee had admitted taking 150 million won ($181,000) from the arms dealer in April last year.

The main opposition National Congress for New Politics has charged that Lee and the arms dealer split a 300 million won ($362,000) bribe from Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd last year to arrange the government purchase.

Lee has not commented publicly on the charges, but state media earlier quoted him as denying any wrongdoing. Daewoo said it gave money to the arms dealer but insisted it was a commission, not a bribe.
